description: Bounded negative result for intent i003 (branch vhost-virtio-guestmem, snapshot s01 only). No check-then-use double-fetch on guest-writable shared memory was found in the audited host-side virtio ring readers. Evidence: (1) drivers/vhost/vhost.c vhost_get_vq_desc_n() (lines 2822-2940) copies each guest descriptor into a stack-local struct vring_desc via vhost_get_desc()->vhost_copy_from_user (vhost.c:1582) and performs both validation (i < vq->num at 2851, indirect/write flag checks at 2870/2889) and consumption (translate_desc of desc.addr/desc.len at 2902-2903) on that single local copy; next_desc() (2695) uses READ_ONCE on the local copy. (2) get_indirect() (2705-2789) reads indirect->len once into a local, then pulls each indirect descriptor via copy_from_iter_full before validating and translating it. (3) drivers/vhost/vringh.c __vringh_iov() copies each descriptor via copydesc_* callbacks into a local struct vring_desc before rcheck range validation and iovec construction; the desc.len/desc.addr re-reads at 412-421 are of the local copy. (4) __vringh_get_head (38-68) and vhost's vhost_get_avail_head fetch the avail ring head exactly once into a local and validate/consume the same value. (5) vhost_scsi (copy_from_iter_full of request header at scsi.c:1230), vhost_vsock (copy_from_iter of header at vsock.c:377), and vhost_net XDP path (copy_from_iter into page frag at net.c:712) all parse guest-supplied headers from kernel-local copies. 8 candidates classified safe with exact file:line evidence; 3 left unresolved within declared bounds (drivers/vdpa/vdpa_user/vduse_dev.c message/iova paths, drivers/vdpa/vdpa_sim + mlx5_vnet + caif_virtio ancillary buffer handling beyond their vringh calls, virt/kvm). No credible finding satisfies the seed invariant (untrusted shared-memory source + value validated and then independently re-fetched for use), so findings list is empty. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i003.json contains the full structured per-candidate evidence and limitations.
